$comment: The golden ledger (scripts/test-goldens.mts): every golden frame a branch is meant to move, keyed "<house>/<shot>@<t>" (e.g. "vanilla/door-to-core@1"), each { "cause": "what changed and why", "stream": "S1" }. A listed frame that moves passes as expected; one that does not move fails; an unlisted frame that moves fails. Goldens are re-blessed once, at integration, and that commit empties this file.
